title: Function-on-function nonlinear autoregressive model (F2NARX) for probabilistic surrogate modeling of stochastic dynamical systems
abstract: arXiv:2602.01929v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Constructing accurate and computationally efficient surrogate models for predicting dynamical system responses is critical in many engineering domains, yet remains challenging due to the strongly nonlinear and high-dimensional mapping from external excitations and system parameters to system responses. This work introduces a novel Function-on-Function Nonlinear AutoRegressive model with eXogenous inputs (F2NARX), which reformulates the recently proposed $\mathcal{F}$-NARX method from a function-on-function regression perspective. The proposed framework substantially improves predictive efficiency while maintaining high accuracy. By combining principal component analysis with Gaussian process regression, F2NARX further enables probabilistic predictions of dynamical responses via the unscented transform in an autoregressive manner. The effectiveness of the method is demonstrated through case studies of varying complexity. Results

translated_title: 用于随机动力系统概率代理建模的函数对函数非线性自回归模型（F2NARX）
translated_abstract: 在许多工程领域，构建准确且计算高效的代理模型来预测动力系统响应至关重要，但由于从外部激励和系统参数到系统响应的映射具有强非线性与高维特性，这一任务依然充满挑战。本工作提出了一种新颖的函数对函数非线性自回归模型（Function-on-Function Nonlinear AutoRegressive model with eXogenous inputs，简称 F2NARX），该模型从函数对函数回归的视角对近期提出的 F-NARX 方法进行了重新构建。所提出的框架在保持高精度的同时显著提升了预测效率。通过将主成分分析与高斯过程回归相结合，F2NARX 进一步能够以自回归的方式、借助无迹变换（unscented transform）实现对动力系统响应的概率预测。该方法的有效性通过不同复杂度的案例研究得到了验证。
tldr: 本文提出 F2NARX 模型，将 F-NARX 重新表述为函数对函数回归问题，并结合主成分分析、高斯过程回归与无迹变换，在保持高精度的同时大幅提升预测效率，实现对随机动力系统响应的高效概率预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes F2NARX, a function-on-function nonlinear autoregressive model that reformulates F-NARX and combines PCA, Gaussian process regression, and the unscented transform to achieve highly efficient and accurate probabilistic surrogate predictions of stochastic dynamical system responses.
